name: @estate/notifications-client
description: HTTP client for the notifications service (M9). The wire format is content-free by construction — a send carries a user id, a closed enum kind, a requested channel and an optional deadline; there is no field for text, so no caller can leak estate content into a carrier message (docs/03 §5.4). The client never throws: every failure is an outcome the caller records (vault's delivered_at bookkeeping, settlement's contact trail). Consumers: vault + settlement (send), identity (recipient upsert at the two plaintext-email moments).
